get_emas_tuple_order.meaning: OraclePack.getEMAs() returns the tuple ordered spotEMA(0), fastEMA(1), slowEMA(2), eonsEMA(3), medianTick(4)

tuple_assignment_positional.meaning: Solidity tuple assignment binds by position, so unpacking order determines which EMA value each variable receives

twap_matches_intended.meaning: the TWAP tick computed by twapEMA() equals the intended 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons combination consistent with the system's interpretation of getEMAs()
twap_matches_intended.checkpoint: after twapEMA() computation, before consumption by getTWAP()/dispatchFrom()

liquidation_pricing_correct.meaning: getLiquidationBonus receives sqrtRatioAtTick(twapTick) derived from the intended TWAP, so liquidation bonus/conversion pricing inputs are correct
liquidation_pricing_correct.checkpoint: at liquidation pricing consumption of twapTick

assumptions: The intended TWAP is the report-stated weighted combination 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons; no concrete EMA values are supplied.
Liquidation pricing correctness is observable through the twapTick fed to sqrtRatioAtTick for getLiquidationBonus.

unresolved.description: Report gives the intended TWAP weights (0.6/0.3/0.1) but no concrete EMA values or numeric twapTick, so the equality of computed TWAP to the intended combination is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than an arithmetic identity.
Impacts are stated as potential; no concrete liquidation event or observed mispricing is demonstrated.

limitations: Formalizes only the liquidation-pricing impact; stale-oracle and solvency-misclassification impacts are out of scope for this plan.
The wrong-order unpacking root cause is not encoded as P; only the tuple-order and positional-assignment facts are preconditions.
No concrete numeric TWAP or liquidation bonus values are bound; code-level binding is deferred.
